questions.question: What exact data and package format should the export contain?
questions.recommended: A ZIP containing one UTF-8 CSV of every owned Document's current fields (title, notes, expiry_date, created_at, updated_at, and category, subject, and document_type names), with no attachments or derived data.
questions.why: The ticket does not define the contract, and the current Document model has metadata only while the legacy exporter references nonexistent attachment and issue-date fields.

questions.question: Which snapshot behavior should an export use when vault data changes during preparation?

options.label: A
options.text: A consistent point-in-time snapshot captured when the export request starts

options.label: B
options.text: The latest values read as each record is processed

options.label: C
options.text: The values at the moment the user starts the download

questions.why: A fixed snapshot prevents a large export from mixing undocumented states and matches the specification's stated assumption.

questions.question: Should the first release prepare the export synchronously as a direct download, or use an asynchronous job with a status and later download step?

options.label: A
options.text: Synchronous request that returns the completed download

options.label: B
options.text: Asynchronous job with explicit pending, completed, and failed states

options.label: C
options.text: Synchronous below a defined size limit and asynchronous above it

questions.why: The repository already wires a direct `/vault/export/` endpoint and the current model exports small metadata records, avoiding job storage and notification scope in the first release.

questions.question: Where should the user-facing export action appear?
questions.recommended: Add an Export vault link or button to the authenticated document-list page that targets the existing `vault:export_data` route.
questions.why: The route exists but the current vault template does not link to it, so the usability success criterion cannot be met without defining the entry point.

questions.question: How long should a generated export remain available, and when should it be cleaned up?
questions.recommended: Stream the export directly and retain no generated server-side file after the response completes; if asynchronous generation is selected, expire it after one successful download or 24 hours, whichever comes first.
questions.why: Export retention and download expiration are explicitly missing, and the choice determines whether storage, cleanup, and retry behavior must be implemented.
